questions.q: How do you enter the CLI?
options: The cli command in the OSD menu
The CLI tab or the # character
Through the OSD menu with the sticks
With a stick combination on the radio
questions.explain: The CLI tab in the configurator or the # character in a terminal puts the FC into command line mode.

questions.q: What does the resource command do?
options: Resets the settings of the selected resource
questions.explain: Resource remapping is reassigning a function to another pad, for example a motor to a free output.

options: Do nothing — it is already written
reboot without save — the write happens at startup
questions.explain: Set changes the value in memory; save writes it to flash and reboots.

options: The RPM filter version and its status
questions.explain: get searches by substring — convenient for looking at a group of settings.

questions.q: Can you paste a diff all from another major version?
options: Only on F7 boards and only in dump format
questions.explain: Setting names and meanings change; carry settings between versions section by section and re-read them.

questions.q: How do you save a motor direction reversal with DShot commands?
options: resource MOTOR 1 reverse, then save and reboot
questions.explain: 7/8 are SPIN_DIRECTION_1/2 (a permanent direction), 12 is save settings; 20/21 are the temporary reversal for turtle. Without props.

options: Enters DFU for flashing over USB
questions.explain: It mounts the flash as a USB drive for downloading logs; bl is for DFU.

questions.q: What is the BUILD KEY from status for?
options: Resetting the settings to factory defaults
Checking and reproducing the firmware contents through the cloud build
questions.explain: The build key shows which options are enabled, and the build can be reproduced.
